xrefdescription.para: ACA-01: Adapter capability announcement creation and JSON serialization.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that an AdapterCapabilityAnnouncement can be created, populated, and serialized to JSON with all required fields present.
Verifies that all domain types convert to human-readable strings correctly.

xrefdescription.para: ACA-03: GossipAdapterPublisher initialization and announcement dispatch.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that the gossip publisher correctly initializes and can dispatch announcements to the gossip channel with proper shard ID and timestamp.

xrefdescription.para: ACA-04: Multiple adapter announcements from single shard.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a publisher can announce multiple distinct adapters in sequence and each generates a separate gossip message.
Verifies that announcements correctly reflect adapter withdrawal status (is_withdrawal = true) for adapter downtime or maintenance scenarios.

xrefdescription.para: ACA-06: Custom domain label in announcement.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that custom domain labels are properly included in announcements when the domain type is CUSTOM.

xrefdescription.para: ACA-07: Announcement timestamp is set during gossip publish.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that the publisher sets the announced_at timestamp when publishing an announcement (even if not set by caller).

xrefdescription.para: ACA-08: Shard ID is overwritten by publisher.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that the publisher always sets its own shard_id in announcements, even if the announcement already contained a different shard_id.
Verifies that announcements with empty adapter_id can still be serialized (though would likely be rejected by policy in practice).

xrefdescription.para: ACA-10: Multiple publishers for same shard.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that multiple publisher instances for the same shard can independently publish announcements without interference.

xrefdescription.para: ACA-TRUST-02: A custom reject policy returns REJECT for flagged adapters.

detaileddescription.para: Implements IFederationTrustPolicy inline to simulate a real domain blocklist.

xrefdescription.para: ACA-TRUST-03: TrustDecision enum values are distinct.
ACA-TRUST-04: DKErrorCode::TRUST_GATE_REJECTED is defined and distinct from all other codes.
ACA-TRUST-05: AlwaysPermitTrustPolicy polymorphic dispatch works correctly.

detaileddescription.para: Accesses the policy through the base-class pointer to confirm vtable dispatch.

briefdescription.para: Focused unit tests for adapter capability announcement gossip surfaces.

detaileddescription.para:
Tests the core distributed knowledge capability announcement paths:
announcement creation and JSON serialization
gossip publisher announcement handling
cross-shard capability discovery
privacy-aware capability filtering
Target: Production readiness validation for capability exchange layer. Q3 2026 Hardening: policy-edge semantics and deterministic broadcast behavior.
